# Organic ending visual revision

## Imported space artwork

- **Space-Skybox**, Westbeam: https://opengameart.org/content/space-skybox-0 . The page lists CC0; the downloaded archive includes the author's WTFPL permission. Archive and license are preserved in `Westbeam/`. `skybox/1.png` supplies the distant layered star field.
- **3 Layer Parallax Star and Nebula Field**, TheClicketyBoom: https://opengameart.org/content/3-layer-parallax-star-and-nebula-field . CC0. The previously downloaded `StarlightFree/nebula2.png` is now used for universe parallax clouds. Source art is unchanged.

## Shape references only

- **Neuron**, tarun_tkg: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/neuron-01d20ef702ee41478a8bc1da8082e504 . Used to study the soma, branching dendrites and axon morphology. No mesh or texture was copied.
- **Human Brain**, 3DRT STUDIOS: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/human-brain-7a27c17fd6c0488bb31ab093236a47fb . Used as a cortex/fissure reference. No mesh or texture was copied.

The cortex geometry, neuron branches, organelles and membrane shaders are authored in this project. The planet uses the team's acquired Planet Project ground/cloud maps and NASA Earth Observatory / Suomi NPP VIIRS Black Marble 2016 night lights. Sources, unchanged originals and resampling coordinates are recorded in `NASA/README.txt`. The ending uses a dark blue / warm gold palette and soft atmospheric scattering.
